grammar.prompt: Choose the accurate formal climate description.
grammar.feedback: يتسم requires بـ and agrees with الساحل.
The air is the affected grammatical subject.

grammar.prompt: Which connector must be followed by إِلَى?
grammar.feedback: The fixed result pattern is يؤدي إلى.

grammar.prompt: Choose the accurate subjunctive after أَنْ.
grammar.feedback: نقلل is a sound-ending present verb and takes final fatḥa; it is not one of the five verbs.

grammar.prompt: Which five-verb form is accurate after أَنْ?
options: يَجِبُ عَلَى النَّاسِ أَنْ يُعِيدُونَ التَّدْوِيرَ.
يَجِبُ عَلَى النَّاسِ أَنْ يُعِيدُ التَّدْوِيرَ.
يَجِبُ عَلَى النَّاسِ أَنْ يُعِيدُوا التَّدْوِيرَ.
grammar.feedback: يعيدون is one of the five verbs, so its nūn is omitted.

options: إِذَا لَمْ نُرَشِّدْ المِيَاهَ، فَسَتَزْدَادُ الأَزْمَةُ.
إِذَا لَمْ نُرَشِّدُ المِيَاهَ، فَسَتَزْدَادُ الأَزْمَةُ.
إِذَا لَمْ نُرَشِّدَ المِيَاهَ، فَسَتَزْدَادُ الأَزْمَةُ.
grammar.feedback: لم makes the sound-ending present jussive: نرشّدْ.
Oil is masculine; water is treated as feminine.
After أن, يزداد takes final fatḥa.

grammar.prompt: Which sentence gives a genuine concession?
options: عَلَى الرَّغْمِ المَشْرُوعُ مِنْ أَنَّ مُكَلِّفٌ.
عَلَى الرَّغْمِ مِنْ أَنَّ المَشْرُوعَ مُكَلِّفٌ، فَإِنَّهُ يُوَفِّرُ الطَّاقَةَ لَاحِقًا.
عَلَى الرَّغْمِ مِنْ أَنَّ المَشْرُوعَ مُكَلِّفٌ، فَهُوَ مُكَلِّفٌ.
grammar.feedback: The second clause must genuinely contrast with the concession.

grammar.prompt: Which conclusion is balanced and conditional?
options: التِّقْنِيَّةُ مُفِيدَةٌ إِلَى حَدٍّ مَا، شَرِيطَةَ أَنْ تُطَبَّقَ بِمَسْؤُولِيَّةٍ.
grammar.feedback: The first qualifies the judgement and states a condition.

listening.prompt: Text 1: Which region has the driest climate?
listening.feedback: The scientist says the dry desert climate prevails in the interior.

listening.prompt: Text 1: What has become longer?
listening.feedback: فترات الجفاف أصبحت أطول.

listening.prompt: Text 1: What consequence is named?
listening.feedback: Longer drought increases pressure on groundwater.

listening.prompt: Text 1: Which solution is proposed?
listening.feedback: The scientist proposes reuse and conservation.

listening.prompt: Text 1: Which formal phrase introduces reported information?
listening.feedback: The speaker uses يشار إلى أنَّ.

listening.prompt: Text 1: Which two responses are recommended?
options: More groundwater extraction and more waste
listening.feedback: Both reuse and conservation are named.

listening.prompt: Text 1: What is the overall topic?
listening.feedback: The text links dry climate, drought and groundwater.

listening.prompt: Text 1: Which idea is NOT mentioned?
listening.feedback: The text does not recommend more fossil-fuel use.

listening.prompt: Text 2: What does Salma support?
listening.feedback: Salma supports solar power and smart grids.

listening.prompt: Text 2: What is Omar’s main reservation?
listening.feedback: Omar raises cost and personal-data concerns.

listening.prompt: Text 2: What do both speakers support?
listening.feedback: Both agree on reducing waste.

listening.prompt: Text 2: Where do the speakers disagree?
options: How the technology should be implemented
listening.feedback: They share the goal but differ over implementation.

listening.prompt: Text 2: Why does Salma support smart grids?
listening.feedback: She says they reduce waste.

listening.prompt: Text 2: Which sentence best summarises the exchange?
options: They agree on the goal but differ on method and safeguards.
listening.feedback: The final sentence explicitly distinguishes goal from method.

listening.prompt: Text 3: What percentage of electricity is renewable?
listening.feedback: The expert states 35%.

listening.prompt: Text 3: What changed from the original plan?
options: The completion year moved from 2030 to 2032
listening.feedback: The corrected completion year is 2032.

listening.prompt: Text 3: What is the expert’s final judgement?
options: Technology must be combined with responsible behaviour
listening.feedback: The final statement combines technology and behaviour.

listening.prompt: Text 3: What does 35% measure?
options: The renewable share of electricity production
listening.feedback: It is the renewable share of electricity production.

listening.prompt: Text 3: What was the original completion year?

listening.prompt: Text 3: Which reporting verb introduces the expert’s conclusion?

reading.prompt: What is the article’s central argument?
options: Technology can support environmental action but cannot replace policy and behaviour.
Weather vocabulary is the only important issue.
reading.feedback: The final judgement combines technology, policy and behaviour.

reading.prompt: Which problem is linked to longer drought?
reading.feedback: Longer drought is linked to water scarcity.

reading.prompt: Which passive foregrounds an environmental result?
reading.feedback: يُلوّث الهواء means the air is polluted.

reading.prompt: Which datum is used as evidence?
options: Electricity use fell by 18% in public buildings.
The city has a long name.
reading.feedback: The article gives an 18% measured reduction.

reading.prompt: What does “ها” refer to in “تُرَكَّبُ الأَنْظِمَةُ فِي المَبَانِي لِأَنَّهَا تُقَلِّلُ الهَدْرَ”?
reading.feedback: The systems are what reduce waste.

reading.prompt: Which phrase attributes information to a source?
What limitation of smart systems is acknowledged?
reading.feedback: Both cost and data privacy are named.

reading.prompt: Why does the writer mention public transport?
options: As a cause of all water scarcity
As an example of social media
As a practical way to reduce emissions
reading.feedback: It is presented as an emissions solution.

reading.prompt: What tone best describes the article?
reading.feedback: The text balances evidence, benefit and limitation.
